name: 73069 · Norman, OK
findings: ZIP 73069 (Norman) has 173 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 68 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73069 (Norman) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 73069 (Norman) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
